# `aitbc workflow stop`

Stop a running workflow by its execution ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc workflow stop [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--workflow-name` | text | — | yes | The Workflow name. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc workflow stop --workflow-name <workflow_name>
```
